objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has also added registry run keys within `HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\MicrosoftUpdate` to enable persistence on Windows devices after reboot. (Citation: Microsoft Axios Compromise APR 2026) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has executed a multiplatform implant that dropped a Registry Run key to `:\ProgramData\NodePackages\` for persistence on Windows machines.(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has obtained boot- persistence on compromised systems independent of user logon by adding the registry key `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\services\scdev\Parameters`.(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026)
